title: VIPJoinPlus
description: Multi-Language Join & Quit Messages | MiniMessage, HEX, Ranks & Folia
body:
![VIPJOINPLUS](https://i.imgur.com/vspai4z.png)

## About VIPJoinPlus

VIPJoinPlus is a modern, lightweight and fully customizable join & quit message plugin for servers that want more than plain chat lines.

Give your VIPs and ranked players the spotlight they deserve with gradients, HEX colors, hover & click events, and, uniquely, join/quit messages that are shown to every player in their own language.

## Highlights

- **Per-player languages** every online player sees the message in their own client language
- **Permission-based groups** with a smart priority system
- **Modern formatting** with MiniMessage (gradients, HEX, hover & click)
- **Lightweight & Folia-ready**

## Compatibility

- Java 21 or higher
- Spigot, Paper and Folia (1.21+)
- **Requires the free Nexus core plugin** → [Download the latest Nexus](https://github.com/MrNickax/Nexus/releases/latest) (install it alongside VIPJoinPlus)

## Features

- Custom join & quit messages based on permissions (VIPs, ranks, etc.)
- Smart priority system when a player matches multiple groups
- Per-player localization, drop a `lang/<language>.yml` file and the message is shown to each viewer in their own language (English & Spanish included)
- Modern formatting with MiniMessage (gradients, HEX, hover & click events)
- Multiple formatting modes: MiniMessage, Legacy (& codes) and Mixed
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Optionally hide the default vanilla join & quit messages
- Configurable join & quit message delays
- Async & performance-friendly
- Reload-safe clean reloads (PlugMan-friendly), no stale or duplicated messages
- Built-in debug mode to diagnose group matching and delivery

## Commands

- `/vipjoinplus reload` → Reload the configuration and language files

## Permissions

- `vipjoinplus.reload` → Allows reloading the plugin
- `group.<name>` → Assigns a player to a message group (configurable per group)

## Why VIPJoinPlus?

Most join/quit plugins are outdated, limited, or speak a single language.

VIPJoinPlus focuses on modern formatting, clean configuration and real customization for VIPs and ranked players, with first-class per-player localization, while staying lightweight and fully compatible with the latest server software, including Folia.
